requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

643-1486-3734-4231--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Maskwood Nexus, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Phyrexian Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Maskwood Nexus, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

3375-4659-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to The Immortal Sun, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5571-7310-8249--6.description:
Use Kitsune to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2961-3175-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

654-851-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2290-3097-5641.easyPrerequisites: Spike Feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2290-3097-5641.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's last ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5742-5743-6441-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

656-5660-7388.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-1849-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

3525-4348-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat.

565-1858-7057--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-7057--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

3000-4508-5880-5929.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2511-4681-4894-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1115-1270-3228-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

1329-2099-2178-3652.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2099-2178-3652.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

5147-6243-6288.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

719-997-1429-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-997-1429-5402.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1652-2350-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-2350-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

997-2730-4871-5006.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
997-2730-4871-5006.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den dies, Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Lurrus of the Dream-Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

341-1661-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2232-2537-3908.description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Spark Double to your hand if its on the battlefield, or returning nothing to your hand otherwise.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting Spark Double onto the battlefield as a copy of Ghalta from your hand.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

90-1339-1926.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Insect" chosen with Species Specialist and Engineered Plague.
90-1339-1926.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Species Specialist triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1633-1887-2060-3415-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Conspiracy Theorist's second ability triggers, allowing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard if it was a nonland card and cast it from exile this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

851-2816-2916-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Pippin does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Pippin.
851-2816-2916-4659.description:
Activate Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Pippin by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

224-596-1921-4547.notablePrerequisites:
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
224-596-1921-4547.description:
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it, sacrificing two artifact tokens and exiling Darksteel Citadel from your graveyard, causing you to create a token of Darksteel Citadel.
When the Darksteel Citadel token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate the Darksteel Citadel token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Forsaken Monument triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Darksteel Citadel token and causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

2978-4499-4893-5313.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {1}, blinking Bookwurm.
Bookwurm enters the battlefield, causing you to gain three life and draw a card.
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying three life, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3230-4222-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Ley Druid.
3230-4222-4348.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
